parameters.question: Compare rMATS A3SS.MATS.JC.txt outputs: records must match on chromosome, splice-site positions, strand, and per-sample junction counts (IJC/SJC); IncLevel (PSI) values within +/-0.01; PValue and FDR within +/-0.01; column order and row order may differ (ID column may differ).

Compare rMATS A5SS.MATS.JC.txt outputs (alternative 5' splice site events using junction counts). Match events by genomic coordinates (chr, strand, longExonStart/End, shortES/EE, flankingES/EE) and gene, not by numeric ID. Then compare junction counts (IJC/SJC), IncLevel values, IncLevelDifference, PValue and FDR, allowing minor numeric rounding and row/column reordering.

Compare rMATS skipped-exon (SE.MATS.JC.txt) outputs: match events by gene and exon coordinates (exonStart_0base, exonEnd, upstream/downstream exon coordinates). Check that junction counts (IJC/SJC), IncLevels, IncLevelDifference, PValue and FDR agree within minor numeric rounding. Event IDs, row order and column order may differ.
